# linkedin

## LINKEDIN_CREATE_ARTICLE_OR_URL_SHARE
Tool to create an article or URL share on LinkedIn using the UGC Posts API. Use when you need to share a link with optional commentary on LinkedIn. Supports sharing URLs as articles with customizable visibility settings.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateArticleOrUrlShareRequest",
  "required": [
    "author",
    "specificContent",
    "visibility"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "author": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Author",
      "pattern": "^urn:li:(person|organization):[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$",
      "examples": [
        "urn:li:person:F6kGF1Uduq",
        "urn:li:organization:123456"
      ],
      "description": "URN of the author (person or organization). For a person: 'urn:li:person:{id}'. For an organization: 'urn:li:organization:{id}'. Use GET_MY_INFO action to get your person ID."
    },
    "visibility": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Visibility",
      "required": [
        "com.linkedin.ugc.MemberNetworkVisibility"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "com.linkedin.ugc.MemberNetworkVisibility": {
          "enum": [
            "PUBLIC",
            "CONNECTIONS",
            "LOGGED_IN"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Com.Linkedin.Ugc.Member Network Visibility",
          "description": "Visibility level for the post. Use 'PUBLIC' to make visible to everyone, 'CONNECTIONS' for connections only, or 'LOGGED_IN' for signed-in members."
        }
      },
      "description": "Visibility settings for the post. Controls who can see the shared content.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "lifecycleState": {
      "enum": [
        "PUBLISHED",
        "DRAFT"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Lifecycle State",
      "default": "PUBLISHED",
      "description": "State of the post. Use 'PUBLISHED' to post immediately or 'DRAFT' to save as draft."
    },
    "specificContent": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Specific Content",
      "required": [
        "com.linkedin.ugc.ShareContent"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "com.linkedin.ugc.ShareContent": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Com.Linkedin.Ugc.Share Content",
          "required": [
            "shareMediaCategory",
            "media"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "media": {
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "type": "object",
                "title": "MediaItem",
                "required": [
                  "originalUrl"
                ],
                "properties": {
                  "title": {
                    "type": "object",
                    "title": "TitleOrDescription",
                    "required": [
                      "text"
                    ],
                    "properties": {
                      "text": {
                        "type": "string",
                        "title": "Text",
                        "description": "The text content."
                      }
                    },
                    "description": "Title or description text object.",
                    "additionalProperties": false
                  },
                  "status": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "title": "Status",
                    "default": "READY",
                    "examples": [
                      "READY"
                    ],
                    "description": "Status of the media. Use 'READY' for URL shares."
                  },
                  "description": {
                    "type": "object",
                    "title": "TitleOrDescription",
                    "required": [
                      "text"
                    ],
                    "properties": {
                      "text": {
                        "type": "string",
                        "title": "Text",
                        "description": "The text content."
                      }
                    },
                    "description": "Title or description text object.",
                    "additionalProperties": false
                  },
                  "originalUrl": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "title": "Original Url",
                    "examples": [
                      "https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/",
                      "https://example.com/article"
                    ],
                    "description": "The URL to be shared. Must be a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL."
                  }
                },
                "description": "Media item for article or URL share."
              },
              "title": "Media",
              "maxItems": 1,
              "minItems": 1,
              "description": "Array of media items to share. For article/URL shares, include one MediaItem with the URL."
            },
            "shareCommentary": {
              "type": "object",
              "title": "Share Commentary",
              "description": "Optional commentary text to accompany the shared URL. Should be a dict with 'text' key.",
              "additionalProperties": {
                "type": "string"
              }
            },
            "shareMediaCategory": {
              "enum": [
                "ARTICLE",
                "NONE"
              ],
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Share Media Category",
              "description": "Media category for the share. Use 'ARTICLE' for URL shares, 'NONE' for text-only posts."
            }
          },
          "description": "Share content configuration for article or URL shares.",
          "additionalProperties": false
        }
      },
      "description": "Container for the share content including URL, commentary, and media category.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for creating an article or URL share on LinkedIn."
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "CreateArticleOrUrlShareResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "CreateArticleOrUrlShareResponse",
      "required": [
        "id"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Id",
          "description": "The URN of the newly created UGC post (e.g., 'urn:li:ugcPost:123456789')."
        },
        "author": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Author",
          "description": "URN of the author who created the post."
        },
        "created": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Created",
          "description": "Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the post was created."
        },
        "lastModified": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Last Modified",
          "description": "Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the post was last modified."
        },
        "lifecycleState": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Lifecycle State",
          "description": "Current lifecycle state of the post (e.g., 'PUBLISHED', 'DRAFT')."
        }
      },
      "description": "Response from creating an article or URL share."
    }
  },
  "title": "CreateArticleOrUrlShareResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "required": [
        "id"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Id",
          "description": "The URN of the newly created UGC post (e.g., 'urn:li:ugcPost:123456789')."
        },
        "author": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Author",
          "description": "URN of the author who created the post."
        },
        "created": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Created",
          "description": "Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the post was created."
        },
        "lastModified": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Last Modified",
          "description": "Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the post was last modified."
        },
        "lifecycleState": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Lifecycle State",
          "description": "Current lifecycle state of the post (e.g., 'PUBLISHED', 'DRAFT')."
        }
      },
      "description": "Data from the action execution"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
    "successful": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",
      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```

## LINKEDIN_CREATE_COMMENT_ON_POST
Tool to create a first-level or nested comment on a LinkedIn share, UGC post, or parent comment via the Social Actions Comments API. Use when you need to engage with posts by adding comments or replying to existing comments. Supports text comments with optional @-mentions and image attachments.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateCommentOnPostRequest",
  "required": [
    "target_urn",
    "actor",
    "object",
    "message"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "actor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Actor",
      "examples": [
        "urn:li:person:abcd1234",
        "urn:li:organization:9876543"
      ],
      "description": "Entity which authored the comment. For personal comments: 'urn:li:person:{id}'. For organization comments: 'urn:li:organization:{id}'. Use the GET_USER_INFO action to retrieve the 'id' field."
    },
    "object": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object",
      "examples": [
        "urn:li:share:7123456789012345678",
        "urn:li:ugcPost:7123456789012345678"
      ],
      "description": "The URN of the share or ugcPost that contains the comment. Typically the same as target_urn for first-level comments, or the root post URN for nested comments. Must be 'urn:li:share:{id}' or 'urn:li:ugcPost:{id}'. Activity URNs ('urn:li:activity:{id}') are NOT supported."
    },
    "content": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "ContentEntity",
        "required": [
          "entity"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "entity": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "Entity",
            "examples": [
              {
                "image": "urn:li:image:C4D00AAAAbBCDEFGhiJ"
              }
            ],
            "description": "Contains the content entity URN. For images: {'image': 'urn:li:image:C4D00AAAAbBCDEFGhiJ'}.",
            "additionalProperties": {
              "type": "string"
            }
          }
        },
        "description": "Content entity for images or other media in the comment."
      },
      "title": "Content",
      "description": "Array of content entities such as images to include in the comment. Each entity should contain an image URN or other content type."
    },
    "message": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Message",
      "required": [
        "text"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "text": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Text",
          "examples": [
            "Great post!",
            "Thanks for sharing @[Name](urn:li:person:123)!"
          ],
          "maxLength": 1250,
          "minLength": 1,
          "description": "The text content of the comment. Supports plain text and @-mentions."
        },
        "attributes": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "MessageAttribute",
            "required": [
              "length",
              "start",
              "value"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "start": {
                "type": "integer",
                "title": "Start",
                "examples": [
                  0
                ],
                "description": "Start position of the mention in the message text."
              },
              "value": {
                "type": "object",
                "title": "Value",
                "examples": [
                  {
                    "person": "urn:li:person:123"
                  },
                  {
                    "organization": "urn:li:organization:456"
                  }
                ],
                "description": "Contains the mention entity. For person mentions: {'person': 'urn:li:person:123'}. For organization mentions: {'organization': 'urn:li:organization:456'}.",
                "additionalProperties": {
                  "type": "string"
                }
              },
              "length": {
                "type": "integer",
                "title": "Length",
                "examples": [
                  10
                ],
                "description": "Length of the mention text in the message."
              }
            },
            "description": "Attribute for @-mentions in comment text."
          },
          "title": "Attributes",
          "description": "Array of attributes for @-mentions in the comment text. Use this to mention specific people or organizations in the comment."
        }
      },
      "description": "The comment message content including text and optional @-mentions.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "target_urn": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Target Urn",
      "examples": [
        "urn:li:share:7123456789012345678",
        "urn:li:ugcPost:7123456789012345678",
        "urn:li:comment:(urn:li:share:7123456789012345678,7198765432109876543)"
      ],
      "description": "The URN of the share, UGC post, or parent comment where the comment will be created. Must be 'urn:li:share:{id}', 'urn:li:ugcPost:{id}', or 'urn:li:comment:({parentUrn},{commentId})'. Activity URNs ('urn:li:activity:{id}') are NOT supported."
    },
    "parentComment": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Parent Comment",
      "examples": [
        "urn:li:comment:(urn:li:share:7123456789012345678,7198765432109876543)"
      ],
      "description": "For nested comments (replies), the URN of the parent comment being replied to. Format: 'urn:li:comment:({parentUrn},{commentId})'. Leave empty for first-level comments on the post."
    }
  }
}
```

```json
                  },
                  "length": {
                    "type": "integer",
                    "title": "Length",

                },
                "description": "Attribute for @-mentions in comment text."

          },
          "description": "The comment message content."
        },
        "commentUrn": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Comment Urn",
          "description": "The URN of the newly created comment."
        },
        "x_restli_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "X Restli Id",
          "description": "The ID of the newly created comment from the x-restli-id response header."
        },
        "lastModified": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Last Modified",
          "properties": {
            "time": {
              "type": "integer",
              "title": "Time",
              "description": "Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the comment was last modified."
            },
            "actor": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Actor",
              "description": "URN of the entity that last modified the comment."
            },
            "impersonator": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Impersonator",
              "description": "URN of the person who acted on behalf of the actor (for organization comments)."
            }
          },
          "description": "Last modification metadata including actor, impersonator, and timestamp."
        }
      },
      "description": "Data from the action execution"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
    "successful": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",
      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```

## LINKEDIN_CREATE_LINKED_IN_POST
Creates a new post on LinkedIn for the authenticated user or an organization they manage. Requires w_member_social scope for posting as a person, and w_organization_social scope for posting as an organization (with ADMINISTRATOR, DIRECT_SPONSORED_CONTENT_POSTER, or CONTENT_ADMIN role).

**Input schema:**

```json
  "required": [

    "commentary"

  "properties": {
    "author": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Author",

        "urn:li:organization:987654321"

For a person: use 'urn:li:person:<actual_person_id>' (e.g., 'urn:li:person:F6kGF1Uduq' or 'urn:li:person:123456789'). Requires w_member_social scope. For an organization: use 'urn:li:organization:<actual_org_id>' (e.g., 'urn:li:organization:987654321'). Requires w_organization_social scope and you must have ADMINISTRATOR, DIRECT_SPONSORED_CONTENT_POSTER, or CONTENT_ADMIN role for the organization.                 }
              },
```
```json
              "description": "Celebration content details. Available for non-sponsored (organic) posts only."
            }

          "title": "Ad Context",

            },
            "dscName": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Dsc Name",
              "description": "Plain text name of the DSC post."
            },
            "dscAdType": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Dsc Ad Type",
              "description": "Type of DSC content. Possible values: VIDEO, STANDARD, CAROUSEL, JOB_POSTING, NATIVE_DOCUMENT, EVENT. This field is read-only."
            },
            "dscStatus": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Dsc Status",
              "description": "Status of the DSC post. Possible values: ACTIVE, ARCHIVED. This field is read-only and required when isDsc is true."
            },
            "dscAdAccount": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Dsc Ad Account",
              "description": "URN of the sponsored account that created the DSC post (e.g., urn:li:sponsoredAccount:520866471). This field is read-only and required when isDsc is true."
            }
          },
          "description": "Advertising-specific metadata for Direct Sponsored Content (DSC) posts."
        },
        "container": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Container",
          "description": "Container entity URN. Optional field for posts within a specific container."
        },
        "createdAt": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Created At",
          "description": "Timestamp when the post was created, in milliseconds since epoch. This field is read-only."
        },
        "commentary": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Commentary",
          "description": "User-generated commentary or text content for the post."
        },
        "visibility": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Visibility",
          "description": "Visibility restrictions for the post. Possible values: CONNECTIONS, PUBLIC, LOGGED_IN, CONTAINER."
        },
        "publishedAt": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Published At",
          "description": "Timestamp when the content was published, in milliseconds since epoch. This field is read-only."
        },
        "x_restli_id": {

                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },

                  },
                  "locations": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "title": "Locations",
                    "description": "Array of location URNs for targeting. This field is deprecated; use geoLocations instead."
                  },
                  "industries": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "title": "Industries",
                    "description": "Array of industry URNs for targeting."
                  },
                  "seniorities": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "title": "Seniorities",
                    "description": "Array of seniority level URNs for targeting."
                  },
                  "geoLocations": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "title": "Geo Locations",
                    "description": "Array of geographic location URNs for targeting (e.g., urn:li:geo:103644278)."
                  },
                  "jobFunctions": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "title": "Job Functions",
                    "description": "Array of job function URNs for targeting."
                  },
                  "fieldsOfStudy": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "title": "Fields Of Study",
                    "description": "Array of field of study URNs for targeting."
                  },
                  "organizations": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "title": "Organizations",
                    "description": "Array of organization URNs (schools) for targeting."
                  },
                  "interfaceLocales": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "title": "InterfaceLocale",
                      "required": [

                      ],

                          "type": "string",

                          "minLength": 2,

                        },
                        "language": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "title": "Language",
                          "maxLength": 2,
                          "minLength": 2,
                          "description": "Two-letter lowercase language code (ISO-639), e.g., 'en', 'es', 'de'."
                        }
                      },
                      "description": "Locale object for interface language targeting."
                    },
                    "title": "Interface Locales",
                    "description": "Array of locale objects for interface language targeting."
                  },
                  "staffCountRanges": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "title": "Staff Count Ranges",

                  }

              },

              "type": "string",
              "title": "Feed Distribution",

            },

              },

        },
        "isReshareDisabledByAuthor": {
```

## LINKEDIN_DELETE_LINKED_IN_POST
Deletes a specific LinkedIn post (share) by its unique `share_id`, which must correspond to an existing share.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "DeleteLinkedInPostRequest",
  "required": [
    "share_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "share_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Share Id",
      "examples": [
        "7245341016004718592",
        "urn:li:share:7245341016004718592"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier of the LinkedIn share (post) to be deleted. Accepts either numeric ID (e.g., '7245341016004718592') or URN format (e.g., 'urn:li:share:7245341016004718592')."
    }
  }
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "DeleteLinkedInPostResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "DeleteLinkedInPostResponse",
      "properties": {},
      "description": "Response for LinkedIn DELETE post endpoint. A successful deletion returns HTTP 204 with no response body (empty). Delete operations are idempotent - deleting an already deleted post returns 204. Error responses follow LinkedIn's standard error schema (LinkedInErrorResponse)."
    }
  },
  "title": "DeleteLinkedInPostResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "properties": {},
      "description": "Data from the action execution"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
    "successful": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",
      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```

## LINKEDIN_DELETE_POST
Delete a LinkedIn post using the Posts API REST endpoint. Supports both ugcPost and share URN formats. The endpoint is idempotent - previously deleted posts return success (204).

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "DeletePostRequest",
  "required": [
    "post_urn"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "post_urn": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Post Urn",
      "examples": [
        "urn:li:ugcPost:7890123456",
        "urn:li:share:7428552224689086464"
      ],
      "description": "The URN of the post to delete. Accepts either ugcPost or share URN formats (e.g., 'urn:li:ugcPost:7890123456' or 'urn:li:share:7245341016004718592'). The URN will be URL-encoded automatically."
    }
  }
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "DeletePostResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "DeletePostResponse",
      "required": [
        "deleted"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "deleted": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Deleted",
          "description": "Indicates whether the post was successfully deleted. Always True for successful 204 responses. The endpoint is idempotent - deleting an already deleted post also returns success."
        }
      }
    }
  },
  "title": "DeletePostResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "required": [
        "deleted"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "deleted": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Deleted",
          "description": "Indicates whether the post was successfully deleted. Always True for successful 204 responses. The endpoint is idempotent - deleting an already deleted post also returns success."
        }
      },
      "description": "Data from the action execution"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
    "successful": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",
      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```

## LINKEDIN_DELETE_UGC_POST
Delete a UGC post using the legacy UGC Post API endpoint. Use when you need to delete a post using the v2/ugcPosts endpoint. Deletion is idempotent - previously deleted posts also return success.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "DeleteUgcPostRequest",
  "required": [
    "ugc_post_urn"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "ugc_post_urn": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ugc Post Urn",
      "examples": [
        "urn:li:ugcPost:7890123456",
        "urn:li:share:7245341016004718592"
      ],
      "description": "The URN of the UGC post or share to delete. Format: 'urn:li:ugcPost:{id}' or 'urn:li:share:{id}'. Will be URL-encoded automatically by the action."
    }
  }
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "DeleteUgcPostResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "DeleteUgcPostResponse",
      "required": [
        "deleted"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "deleted": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Deleted",
          "description": "Indicates whether the post was successfully deleted. Always True for successful 204 responses. Post deletions are idempotent, meaning deletion requests for previously deleted posts also return success."
        }
      }
    }
  },
  "title": "DeleteUgcPostResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "required": [
        "deleted"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "deleted": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Deleted",
          "description": "Indicates whether the post was successfully deleted. Always True for successful 204 responses. Post deletions are idempotent, meaning deletion requests for previously deleted posts also return success."
        }
      },
      "description": "Data from the action execution"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
    "successful": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",
      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```

## LINKEDIN_GET_AUDIENCE_COUNTS
Retrieves audience size counts for specified targeting criteria. Use when estimating reach for LinkedIn ad campaigns or targeted content.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetAudienceCountsRequest",
  "required": [
    "targetingCriteria"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "q": {
      "enum": [

        "(include:(and:List((or:(urn%3Ali%3AadTargetingFacet%3Alocations:List(urn%3Ali%3Ageo%3A102221843))))))"
      ],
      "description": "Targeting criteria with URL-encoded URNs. Format: (include:(and:List((or:(urn%3Ali%3AadTargetingFacet%3AFACET:List(urn%3Ali%3ATYPE%3AID)))))). IMPORTANT: Only the URN colons should be encoded as %3A, keep the structure syntax (parentheses, colons in 'and:' and 'or:') unencoded. Example for locations: (include:(and:List((or:(urn%3Ali%3AadTargetingFacet%3Alocations:List(urn%3Ali%3Ageo%3A102221843))))))"
    }
```

## LINKEDIN_GET_COMPANY_INFO
Retrieves organizations where the authenticated user has specific roles (ACLs), to determine their management or content posting capabilities for LinkedIn company pages.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetCompanyInfoRequest",
  "properties": {
    "role": {
      "enum": [
        "ADMINISTRATOR",
        "DIRECT_SPONSORED_CONTENT_POSTER"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Role",
      "default": "ADMINISTRATOR",
      "examples": [
        "ADMINISTRATOR",
        "DIRECT_SPONSORED_CONTENT_POSTER"
      ],
      "description": "The specific role to filter organization ACLs by."
    },
    "count": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Count",
      "default": 10,
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        "10",
        "50",
        "100"
      ],
      "description": "The number of organization ACLs to return per page."
    },
    "start": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Start",
      "default": 0,
      "minimum": 0,
      "examples": [
        "0",
        "10",
        "20"
      ],
      "description": "The starting index for pagination, representing the number of initial ACLs to skip."
    },
    "state": {
      "enum": [
        "APPROVED",
        "REQUESTED"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "State",
      "default": "APPROVED",
      "examples": [
        "APPROVED",
        "REQUESTED"
      ],
      "description": "The approval state of the role to filter by."
    }
  },
  "description": "Parameters for listing organizations where the authenticated user has specific roles and permissions (ACLs)."
}
```

## LINKEDIN_GET_IMAGE
Tool to retrieve details of a LinkedIn image using its URN. Use when you need to check image status, get download URLs, or access image metadata for a single image.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetImageRequest",
  "required": [
    "image_urn"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "image_urn": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Image Urn",
      "examples": [
        "urn:li:image:C4E10AQFn10iWtKexVA",
        "C4E10AQFn10iWtKexVA"
      ],
      "description": "The image URN identifier. Can be provided as 'urn:li:image:XXX' or just the ID 'XXX'. The URN will be URL-encoded automatically when making the API request."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for retrieving a single image."
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "ImageStatus": {
      "enum": [
        "PROCESSING",
        "PROCESSING_FAILED",
        "AVAILABLE",
        "WAITING_UPLOAD"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "ImageStatus",
      "description": "Image processing status enumeration."
    },
    "GetImageResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "GetImageResponse",
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Id",
          "description": "Unique URN identifier for the image (read-only, system-generated)."
        },
        "owner": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Owner",
          "description": "URN of the owner entity (person, organization, or sponsoredAccount)."
        },
        "status": {
          "enum": [
            "PROCESSING",
            "PROCESSING_FAILED",
            "AVAILABLE",
            "WAITING_UPLOAD"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Status",
          "description": "Processing status of the image asset (PROCESSING, PROCESSING_FAILED, AVAILABLE, or WAITING_UPLOAD)."
        },
        "altText": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Alt Text",
          "description": "Alternate text for accessibility. Maximum 4,086 characters; recommended under 120."
        },
        "downloadUrl": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Download Url",
          "description": "Public URL to download or view the image. Empty if unavailable or processing failed."
        },
        "aspectRatioWidth": {
          "type": "number",
          "title": "Aspect Ratio Width",
          "description": "Width component of aspect ratio (e.g., 16 for 16:9)."
        },
        "aspectRatioHeight": {
```

## LINKEDIN_GET_IMAGES
Tool to retrieve image metadata including download URLs, status, and dimensions from LinkedIn's Images API. Use when you need to access image details for posts, profiles, or media library assets.

**Input schema:**
```json
{

  "required": [

  ],
  "properties": {
    "ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Ids",
      "examples": [
        [
          "urn:li:image:C4E10AQFn10iWtKexVA"
        ],
        [
          "urn:li:image:C4E10AQFn10iWtKexVA",
          "urn:li:image:C4E10AQFgOYeVoHFeBw"
        ]
      ],
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "List of image URNs to retrieve. Each URN should be in the format 'urn:li:image:{ID}' (e.g., 'urn:li:image:C4E10AQFn10iWtKexVA'). Maximum recommended batch size depends on LinkedIn's API limits."
    },
    "linkedin_version": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Linkedin Version",
      "default": "202511",
      "examples": [
        "202511",
        "202412"
      ],
      "description": "LinkedIn API version in YYYYMM format. Defaults to 202511."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for retrieving image metadata."
}
```

## LINKEDIN_GET_NETWORK_SIZE
Tool to retrieve the follower count for a LinkedIn organization. Use when you need to get the number of members following a specific company or organization on LinkedIn.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetNetworkSizeRequest",
  "required": [
    "organization_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "edgeType": {
      "enum": [
        "COMPANY_FOLLOWED_BY_MEMBER"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Edge Type",
      "default": "COMPANY_FOLLOWED_BY_MEMBER",
      "description": "The type of network relationship to count. Use COMPANY_FOLLOWED_BY_MEMBER to get follower count."
    },
    "linkedinVersion": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Linkedin Version",
      "default": "202510",
      "pattern": "^[0-9]{6}$",
      "examples": [
        "202510",
        "202601"
      ],
      "description": "LinkedIn API version to use for the request. Format: YYYYMM (e.g., 202510 for October 2025)."
    },
    "organization_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Organization Id",
      "pattern": "^[0-9]+$",
      "examples": [
        "3803",
        "79988552"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier for the LinkedIn organization. This is the numeric ID from the organization URN (e.g., for 'urn:li:organization:3803', use '3803')."
    }
  },
  "description": "Parameters for retrieving organization follower count."
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "GetNetworkSizeResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "GetNetworkSizeResponse",
      "required": [
        "firstDegreeSize"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "firstDegreeSize": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "First Degree Size",
          "description": "The count of first-degree connections/followers for the organization. For COMPANY_FOLLOWED_BY_MEMBER edge type, this represents the total number of LinkedIn members following the organization."
        }
      },
      "description": "Response containing the network size (follower count) for an organization."
    }
  },
  "title": "GetNetworkSizeResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "required": [
        "firstDegreeSize"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "firstDegreeSize": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "First Degree Size",
          "description": "The count of first-degree connections/followers for the organization. For COMPANY_FOLLOWED_BY_MEMBER edge type, this represents the total number of LinkedIn members following the organization."
        }
      },
      "description": "Data from the action execution"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
    "successful": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",
      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```

## LINKEDIN_GET_ORG_PAGE_STATS
Tool to retrieve page statistics for a LinkedIn organization page. Use when you need engagement metrics like page views and custom button clicks. Supports both lifetime statistics (all-time data segmented by demographics) and time-bound statistics (aggregate data for specific time ranges). Requires rw_organization_admin permission with ADMINISTRATOR role for the organization.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetOrgPageStatsRequest",
  "required": [
    "organization"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "organization": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Organization",
      "examples": [
        "urn:li:organization:2414183"
      ],
      "description": "Organization URN in format urn:li:organization:{id}. Example: urn:li:organization:2414183"
    },
    "timeRangeEnd": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Time Range End",
      "examples": [
        1552003200000
      ],
      "description": "Inclusive ending timestamp in milliseconds since epoch. Only required for time-bound statistics. Omit for lifetime statistics."
    },
    "timeRangeStart": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Time Range Start",
      "examples": [
        1551398400000
      ],
      "description": "Exclusive starting timestamp in milliseconds since epoch. Only required for time-bound statistics. Omit for lifetime statistics."
    },
    "linkedinVersion": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Linkedin Version",
      "default": "202602",
      "examples": [
        "202602",
        "202601"
      ],
      "description": "LinkedIn API version in YYYYMM format. Defaults to 202602."
    },
    "timeGranularityType": {
      "enum": [
        "DAY",
        "MONTH"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "TimeGranularityType",
      "description": "Granularity of the statistics. Use DAY for daily statistics or MONTH for monthly statistics. Only required for time-bound statistics. Omit for lifetime statistics."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for retrieving organization page statistics from LinkedIn."
}
```

## LINKEDIN_GET_PERSON
Retrieves a LinkedIn member's profile information by their person ID. Returns lite profile fields (name, profile picture) by default, or basic profile fields (including headline and vanity name) with appropriate permissions.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetPersonRequest",
  "required": [
    "person_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "person_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Person Id",
      "examples": [
        "yrZCpj2Z12",
        "F6kGF1Uduq"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the LinkedIn member. Note: Each member id is unique to the context of your application only."
    }
  }
}
```

## LINKEDIN_GET_POST_CONTENT
Tool to retrieve detailed post content including text, images, videos, and metadata from LinkedIn by post URN. Use when you need to fetch the full content and details of a specific LinkedIn post.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetPostContentRequest",
  "required": [
    "post_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "post_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Post Id",
      "examples": [
        "urn:li:ugcPost:7428263313739988992",
        "urn:li:share:7123456789012345678"
      ],
      "description": "Post URN identifier in the format 'urn:li:ugcPost:{id}' or 'urn:li:share:{id}'. Can also be URL-encoded. Example: 'urn:li:ugcPost:7428263313739988992'"
    },
    "linkedin_version": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Linkedin Version",
      "default": "202601",
      "examples": [
        "202601",
        "202511",
        "202504"
      ],
      "description": "LinkedIn API version in YYYYMM format. Defaults to 202601."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for retrieving post content by URN."
}
```

## LINKEDIN_GET_SHARE_STATS
Retrieves share statistics for a LinkedIn organization, including impressions, clicks, likes, comments, and shares. Use to analyze content performance for an organization page. Optionally filter by time intervals to get time-bound statistics.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetShareStatsRequest",
  "required": [
    "organizational_entity"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "time_intervals": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Time Intervals",
      "examples": [
        "(timeRange:(start:1634018799000,end:1634623599000),timeGranularityType:DAY)",
        "(timeRange:(start:1609459200000,end:1612137600000),timeGranularityType:WEEK)"
      ],
      "description": "Time-bound statistics filter in RestLi 2.0 complex object format. Specify time range and granularity as: '(timeRange:(start:<start_timestamp>,end:<end_timestamp>),timeGranularityType:<GRANULARITY>)' where timestamps are in milliseconds since epoch and GRANULARITY is one of: DAY, WEEK, MONTH. Example: '(timeRange:(start:1634018799000,end:1634623599000),timeGranularityType:DAY)'. If omitted, returns lifetime statistics."
    },
    "organizational_entity": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Organizational Entity",
      "examples": [
        "urn:li:organization:2414183",
        "urn:li:organization:123456"
      ],
      "description": "The URN of the organization to retrieve share statistics for. Must be in the format 'urn:li:organization:<id>' where <id> is the organization ID (e.g., 'urn:li:organization:2414183'). Get organization IDs using the GET_COMPANY_INFO action."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for retrieving share statistics for an organization."
}
```

## LINKEDIN_GET_VIDEOS
Retrieves video metadata from LinkedIn Marketing API. Supports single video retrieval, batch retrieval (multiple videos), and finding videos by associated account with pagination. Use when you need to get video details including duration, dimensions, status, download URLs, and media library information.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetVideosRequest",
  "properties": {
    "count": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Count",
      "maximum": 1000,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        10,
        50,
        100
      ],
      "description": "Number of elements to return for pagination, up to 1,000. Only used with 'associated_account'. Defaults to 10."
    },
    "start": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Start",
      "minimum": 0,
      "examples": [
        0,
        10,
        20
      ],
      "description": "Index where returned elements begin for pagination. Only used with 'associated_account'. Defaults to 0."
    },
    "video_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Video Ids",
      "examples": [
        [
          "urn:li:video:C4D10AQE9WE5n4uJKUg",
          "urn:li:video:C5F10AQElP1fVH1Ke6g"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "List of video URNs for batch retrieval (e.g., ['urn:li:video:C4D10AQE9WE5n4uJKUg', 'urn:li:video:C5F10AQElP1fVH1Ke6g']). Use this for batch retrieval. Mutually exclusive with 'video_urn' and 'associated_account'."
    },
    "video_urn": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Video Urn",
      "examples": [
        "urn:li:video:C4E10AQGUkQY7trgh-Q"
      ],
      "description": "Single video URN to retrieve (e.g., 'urn:li:video:C4E10AQGUkQY7trgh-Q'). Use this for single video retrieval. Mutually exclusive with 'video_ids' and 'associated_account'."
    },
    "associated_account": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Associated Account",
      "examples": [
        "urn:li:sponsoredAccount:123456789"
      ],
      "description": "Sponsored account URN to find videos by associated account (e.g., 'urn:li:sponsoredAccount:123456789'). Use this to find all videos for an account. Mutually exclusive with 'video_urn' and 'video_ids'."
    },
    "media_library_status": {
      "enum": [
        "ACTIVE",
        "ARCHIVED"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "MediaLibraryStatusEnum",
      "description": "Filter by media library status. Only used with 'associated_account'. When omitted, returns all videos regardless of status."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for retrieving video metadata from LinkedIn."
}
```

## LINKEDIN_INITIALIZE_IMAGE_UPLOAD
Tool to initialize an image upload to LinkedIn and return a presigned upload URL plus the resulting image URN. Use when you need to prepare an image upload for LinkedIn posts. After calling this tool, upload the image bytes to the returned upload_url via PUT request, then use the image URN in CREATE_LINKED_IN_POST action.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "InitializeImageUploadRequest",
  "required": [
    "owner"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "owner": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Owner",
      "examples": [
        "urn:li:person:F6kGF1Uduq",
        "urn:li:organization:987654321"
      ],
      "description": "Owner URN (person or organization) that will own the uploaded image. Must be in the format 'urn:li:person:{id}' for personal posts or 'urn:li:organization:{id}' for organization posts. Use the GET_MY_INFO action to retrieve the person ID."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for initializing an image upload."
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "InitializeImageUploadResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "InitializeImageUploadResponse",
      "properties": {
        "image": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Image",
          "description": "The image URN to use in posts (e.g., 'urn:li:image:...'). Use this URN when creating posts to attach the uploaded image."
        },
        "uploadUrl": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Upload Url",
          "description": "URL to upload the image file via HTTP PUT request. This URL is temporary and will expire. Upload the image bytes with appropriate Content-Type header (e.g., 'image/jpeg', 'image/png')."
        }
      },
      "description": "Response containing the presigned upload URL and image URN."
    }
  },
  "title": "InitializeImageUploadResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "properties": {
        "image": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Image",
          "description": "The image URN to use in posts (e.g., 'urn:li:image:...'). Use this URN when creating posts to attach the uploaded image."
        },
        "uploadUrl": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Upload Url",
          "description": "URL to upload the image file via HTTP PUT request. This URL is temporary and will expire. Upload the image bytes with appropriate Content-Type header (e.g., 'image/jpeg', 'image/png')."
        }
      },
      "description": "Data from the action execution"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
    "successful": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",
      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```

## LINKEDIN_LIST_REACTIONS
Retrieves reactions (likes, celebrations, etc.) on a LinkedIn entity such as a share, post, or comment. Use when you need to see who reacted to content and what type of reactions were used.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListReactionsRequest",
  "required": [
    "entity"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "sort": {
      "enum": [
        "CHRONOLOGICAL",
        "REVERSE_CHRONOLOGICAL",
        "RELEVANCE"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sort",
      "default": "REVERSE_CHRONOLOGICAL",
      "description": "Sort order for reactions. CHRONOLOGICAL sorts by created date ascending, REVERSE_CHRONOLOGICAL sorts by created date descending (default), RELEVANCE sorts by relevance to the viewer."
    },
    "count": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Count",
      "default": 10,
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "Number of reactions to return per page."
    },
    "start": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Start",
      "default": 0,
      "minimum": 0,
      "description": "Starting index for pagination (number of reactions to skip)."
    },
    "entity": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Entity",
      "examples": [
        "urn:li:activity:7067167295080394752",
        "urn:li:share:7021942390034694144",
        "urn:li:ugcPost:7021942390034694144",
        "urn:li:comment:(activity:7019389037459226624,7021942390034694144)"
      ],
      "description": "The URN of the entity (share, post, or comment) to get reactions for. Format: 'urn:li:share:{id}', 'urn:li:ugcPost:{id}', 'urn:li:activity:{id}', or 'urn:li:comment:(activity:{activityId},{commentId})'. Do not URL-encode this value."
    }
  }
}
```

## LINKEDIN_REGISTER_IMAGE_UPLOAD
Tool to initialize a native LinkedIn image upload for feed shares and return a presigned upload URL plus the resulting digital media asset URN. Use when you need to upload an image to attach to a LinkedIn post. After calling this tool, upload the image bytes to the returned upload_url, then use the asset_urn in LINKEDIN_CREATE_LINKED_IN_POST.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "RegisterImageUploadRequest",
  "required": [
    "owner_urn"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "recipe": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Recipe",
      "default": "urn:li:digitalmediaRecipe:feedshare-image",
      "examples": [
        "urn:li:digitalmediaRecipe:feedshare-image",
        "urn:li:digitalmediaRecipe:profile-image"
      ],
      "description": "The digital media recipe URN specifying the processing recipe for the image. Default is 'urn:li:digitalmediaRecipe:feedshare-image' for feed share images."
    },
    "owner_urn": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Owner Urn",
      "examples": [
        "urn:li:person:123456789",
        "urn:li:organization:987654321"
      ],
      "description": "URN of the owner entity that will own the uploaded image. Must be in the format 'urn:li:person:{id}' for personal posts or 'urn:li:organization:{id}' for organization posts. Use the GET_USER_INFO action to retrieve the person ID."
    },
    "supported_upload_mechanism": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Supported Upload Mechanism",
      "examples": [
        [
          "SYNCHRONOUS_UPLOAD"
        ],
        [
          "MULTIPART_UPLOAD"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Array of supported upload mechanisms. If not specified, LinkedIn will return the default mechanism (typically SYNCHRONOUS_UPLOAD)."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for registering an image upload."
}
```

## LINKEDIN_SEARCH_AD_TARGETING_ENTITIES
Search for ad targeting entities using typeahead search. Use when you need to find targeting entities like geographic locations, job titles, industries, or other targeting criteria for LinkedIn ad campaigns.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SearchAdTargetingEntitiesRequest",
  "required": [
    "query",
    "facet"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "count": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Count",
      "default": 10,
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        10,
        20,
        50
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of results to return per page."
    },
    "facet": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Facet",
      "examples": [
        "urn:li:adTargetingFacet:locations",
        "urn:li:adTargetingFacet:titles",
        "urn:li:adTargetingFacet:industries"
      ],
      "description": "Ad targeting facet URN to specify the entity type to search (e.g., 'urn:li:adTargetingFacet:locations' for geographic locations, 'urn:li:adTargetingFacet:titles' for job titles, 'urn:li:adTargetingFacet:industries' for industries)."
    },
    "query": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Query",
      "examples": [
        "united states",
        "software engineer",
        "technology"
      ],
      "description": "Search query string to find targeting entities (e.g., 'united states', 'software engineer', 'technology')."
    },
    "start": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Start",
      "default": 0,
      "minimum": 0,
      "examples": [
        0,
        10,
        20
      ],
      "description": "Starting index for pagination, representing the number of initial results to skip."
    },
    "queryVersion": {
      "enum": [
        "QUERY_USES_URNS"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "QueryVersionEnum",
      "description": "Query version for the search request."
    }
  },
  "description": "Parameters for searching ad targeting entities using typeahead search."
}
```
